chief_complaint.chief_complaint: Requesting removal of lower left wisdom teeth

present_illness.present_illness: The patient reported that the left lower wisdom tooth had been repeatedly inflamed and he now came to our hospital for treatment.
present_illness.past_history: He denies any history of systemic diseases, family history, drug allergies, or dental treatment.

oral_examination.oral_examination: Low vertical impaction, one-quarter of the tooth crown exposed, no abnormality in the mucosa, and the rest is normal, and the remaining teeth need to be investigated. CBCT showed 38 low-level impaction, the surrounding bone tissue was normal, and there was no abnormality in the root tip.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid biting hard food, pay attention to oral hygiene, and return to the clinic regularly. Eat and drink after 2 hours.

source_handle: 1. Inform the patient of the relevant costs and precautions, give informed consent to the treatment and sign a tooth extraction consent form. 2. Local iodophor disinfection, left mandibular block anesthesia with 2% lidocaine, local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine, incision of the flap, loosening of the teeth, removal of the tooth extraction forceps, routine scraping of the extraction socket, and extraction socket Reset and apply a stitch to stop bleeding.
